messages:
sam-partnerships: Quick sync: building a modular private-offer for ACME covering committed spend, an appliance credit, and a renewal glide path. Need tight feedback on tier sizing and legal constraints.

lina-finance: Can you share target LTV / CAC assumptions? I'll plug into the model once I have commit tiers and ramp credits.

sam-partnerships: Thinking tiers: 75k / 300k / 1.2M. Proposed discounts 10% / 18% / 25%. Ramp: 3-month usage credit (up to 25% of commit) to help adoption.

owen-sales: Frontline says middle tier (300k) is most realistic for strategic SI deals. Appliance credit must be visible to sellers; 25% ramp sounds high but strong hook for close.

tess-legal: Heads up appliance credits via SOW only. Need separate billing doc and IP/data residency clauses if ACME wants on-prem hardware. Also propose a simple early-termination recoup schedule.

raj-engineering: If we promise appliance-backed dedicated pool, ops uplift ~+15% and lead time 3-5 weeks. Also add clause: guaranteed throughput only with pre-provisioned capacity.

jenna-marketing: Launch cadence: partner case study + co-branded webinar. Recommend private pilot (SI + 1 customer) 2 weeks before public listing to prime comms.

sam-partnerships: Suggested renewal smoothing: Year2 discount = Year1 - 4pts, Year3 = Year2 - 2pts. Also include an optional conversion credit for usage that exceeds commit in year1.

lina-finance: I will run margin sims today with CPI assumptions. Need estimate: avg tokens/day per customer? Raj?

raj-engineering: Ballpark: pilot customers typically 400-800M tokens/month depending on app. For dedicated pools assume 60% utilization initially.

ops-bot: Deploy reminder: private-offer template v3 must be used for marketplace ingestion. Link: https://redwood.internal/templates/po-v3

owen-sales: Sales ask: include a partner success SLA milestone (onboarding completion within 30 days) to trigger first invoice. Reduces friction on start-ups.

tess-legal: Will draft SOW snippet + ET recoup clause. Also will add export control language for appliances crossing regions. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

jenna-marketing: I'll reserve webinar slot the week of May 12. Lock creative briefs by Apr 28.

sam-partnerships: Great. I'll post a v2 with final tiers + a sample customer-facing offer table tomorrow. Thanks all. :rocket:
